description: This file defines the LeaveRequestCommentService class within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin. It provides a service layer to access LeaveRequestCommentDao objects, following typical DAO service pattern. It handles lazy initialization of the DAO and exposes it via a getter method.

classes.name: LeaveRequestCommentService
classes.description: A service class providing access to the LeaveRequestCommentDao, responsible for handling leave request comments within the leave module.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestCommentDao
methods.description: Returns an instance of LeaveRequestCommentDao, creating it if it has not been initialized yet.
